2607.17601.title: Trustworthy Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction via Reliability-Aware Multi-Engine Fusion
2607.17601.paper_summary: Accurate protein-ligand binding affinity prediction is central to computational drug discovery, yet modern docking engines frequently disagree without indicating which prediction to trust. Consensus scoring and ensemble methods improve mean accuracy but treat all predictions identically without interpretable confidence measures or uncertainty decomposition, ignoring the chemical context of each protein-ligand pair. To address this limitation, we introduce RELIABLE-BA (RELIABiLity-aware Evidential fusion for Binding Affinity), an evidential framework for multi-engine binding affinity prediction. Our model comprises three steps: (1) modeling each engine as an evidential expert via Normal-Inverse-Gamma distributions, (2) scaling epistemic uncertainty through learned reliability from molecular context while preserving each expert's predictive mean, and (3) fusing experts through closed-form aggregation that captures both individual uncertainty and inter-engine disagreement. Experiments on the PDBBind and BDB2020+ benchmarks demonstrate competitive point prediction with substantially improved uncertainty calibration, and additional validation on the SARS-CoV-2 Mpro dataset and 5HT2A receptor demonstrates applicability to clinically relevant drug targets. Crucially, these uncertainty estimates enable reliable filtering of protein-ligand pairs, reducing prediction error by up to 25% when retaining only high-confidence pairs. To our knowledge, RELIABLE-BA is the first multi-engine binding affinity prediction framework to combine evidential fusion with context-dependent reliability, offering a principled path toward trustworthy AI-guided drug discovery. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yongchand/RELIABLE-BA.
2607.17601.paper_summary_zh: 準確的蛋白質-配體結合親和力預測是計算藥物發現的核心，然而現代對接引擎經常存在分歧，卻未能指明應該信任哪個預測。共識評分和集成方法提高了平均準確性，但對所有預測一視同仁，缺乏可解釋的信心度量或不確定性分解，忽略了每對蛋白質-配體的化學背景。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了RELIABLE-BA（RELIABiLity-aware Evidential fusion for Binding Affinity），這是一個多引擎結合親和力預測的證據框架。我們的模型包含三個步驟：（1）通過正規-逆伽馬分佈將每個引擎建模為證據專家，（2）通過從分子背景中學習的可靠性來調整認知不確定性，同時保留每個專家的預測均值，以及（3）通過封閉形式的聚合融合專家，捕捉個體不確定性和引擎間的不一致性。在PDBBind和BDB2020+基準上的實驗顯示出具有競爭力的點預測，並顯著改善了不確定性校準，對SARS-CoV-2 Mpro數據集和5HT2A受體的額外驗證顯示了對臨床相關藥物靶點的適用性。關鍵是，這些不確定性估計使得可靠地篩選蛋白質-配體對成為可能，在僅保留高信心對的情況下將預測誤差降低了多達25%。據我們所知，RELIABLE-BA是第一個將證據融合與上下文相關的可靠性結合的多引擎結合親和力預測框架，為可信的AI引導藥物發現提供了一條原則性途徑。我們的代碼已公開在 https://github.com/yongchand/RELIABLE-BA。
